content.comment_body: We currently have some [article_no] units that were installed some time ago. We're using Version 5 of [product_name] and have been able to connect to these units and upload the program to a laptop. When we restart the processor, the online test function is not available, and starting or stopping the processor remotely from the laptop isn't possible—these actions can only be done using the physical keys on the front of the unit. Is the online test feature supported with [article_no] modules using Version 5 of [product_name]? If yes, how can I access it? I was able to use the online test function on the uploaded program by downloading it from an [article_no] unit into a [article_no] unit. I don't want to download the program again to the [article_no] units until I'm sure this will resolve the issue, as we currently have no other backup.

The online test feature is only supported starting from [article_no]. It doesn't work with [article_no]. Sorry for the inconvenience. You can verify this by navigating to "Tools -> Select Hardware"—if you choose a [article_no] unit, the online test button will not be available. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to use the online test and remote start/stop features with Version 5 of [product_name] and [article_no] modules. This limitation creates confusion about compatibility and increases concerns regarding program backup and handling of the devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to be able to perform online testing and remote start/stop actions using Version 5 of [product_name] and their [article_no] modules.
